svg.title: OpenCode Go expanded sidebar showing the 5-hour, Weekly, and Monthly meters
svg.desc: Terminal-style screenshot of the OpenCode Go sidebar in expanded mode, captured from a 64 by 14 character frame rendered with fake usage data. The 7 visible rows read: OpenCode Go 5-hour 1h 0m 25% ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━───────────────────────────────────────────── Weekly 1d 50% ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━────────────────────────────── Monthly 7d 66% ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━────────────────────
